en.title: Maximum Non-overlapping Teams With a Limited Skill Span
en.description:
Each team has exactly teamSize people, and within a team the highest skill minus the lowest skill must not exceed maxDiff. Each person joins at most one team, and some people may not take part. Find the maximum number of teams.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and editorial; additions for bounds missing from the sources and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n teamSize maxDiff and the second line contains n skill values. The original bounds are 1≤teamSize≤n≤100000, 1≤maxDiff≤10^9, 1≤skill[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are 2; 0; and 3, checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort the skills. If the leftmost k consecutive people can form a team, take the whole segment; otherwise discard the current smallest one.
